articles.title: India’s Ringg gets backing from Peak XV as it pushes voice AI past the phone call
articles.summary: Ringg has raised $10 million from Peak XV as a part of its Series A extension.

articles.title: Robotics startup Generalist reaches $3B valuation, sources say
articles.summary: The $200 million extension comes just months after the physical AI startup reached a $2 billion valuation.

articles.title: OpenAI loses a top data center exec as stream of high-profile departures continues
articles.summary: In a statement to TechCrunch about Malone's departure, OpenAI said it had "recently reorganized" its "infrastructure organization to support the scale and pace of our work."

articles.title: X sends cease-and-desist to open source project Nitter over alleged scraping
articles.summary: X has sent cease-and-desist letters to Nitter, the open source project behind privacy-friendly X front ends, demanding its instances and code repository be taken down over alleged scraping.

articles.title: Instagram’s ‘First Draft’ feature aims to make editing Reels less tedious
articles.summary: Instagram says the process can produce a first pass in under 10 seconds, potentially saving creators significant editing time while making video creation more approachable for people who don't have much experience with editing software.

articles.title: Stability AI, maker of image generator Stable Diffusion, raises $76 million in fresh funding
articles.summary: The company's new fundraising total now stands at $232 million.

articles.title: SpaceX will build a second, $100B ‘Starbase’ spaceport in Louisiana
articles.summary: The company says it will start construction in 2027 and that a Starship rocket could take flight as soon as 2029.

articles.title: Your vote matters! Decide which Audience Choice sessions will make it to TechCrunch Founder Summit
articles.summary: Each year, we get a huge influx of applicants to speak at TechCrunch’s events, and this year’s Founder Summit in Boston on November 4 will be no different!

articles.title: Tonight marks your last chance to save up to $300 on a TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass
articles.summary: If you’ve been circling around Disrupt, then now’s the best time to lock in your pass and start getting ready to join the rest of the startup community gathering in San Francisco from October 13-15 at Moscone West!

articles.title: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat
articles.summary: Anthropic is giving Claude a shared memory across chat and Cowork, so users no longer have to repeatedly brief the AI on projects, preferences, and other context.

articles.title: Waymo robotaxis are headed to Munich
articles.summary: Germany's autonomous vehicle regulations have made it a hotspot for autonomous vehicle testing and eventual commercial robotaxi deployment.

articles.title: Life360 expands pet tracking with new $8 scannable tags and zoomie alerts
articles.summary: Life360’s new $7.99 scannable pet tags alert families when a lost pet is found and share its last known location, while new care-tracking features help households keep tabs on feeding, walks, medication, and more.

articles.title: That fake Grand Theft Auto VI demo is actually just malware
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto fans, eager for news about one of the most anticipated video games of all time, appear especially vulnerable to this new cyberattack.

articles.title: Pacific Fusion’s next fusion machine could clear a key hurdle to commercial power
articles.summary: Fusion startup Pacific Fusion broke ground on a demonstration facility in New Mexico that it says will generate enough energy to power itself.

articles.title: Gamma acquires Accel-backed design startup Lica
articles.summary: Lica co-founders are going to work on Gamma's new research team.

articles.title: Apple rescues Hide My Email feature from the privacy scrap heap
articles.summary: Apple says it will no longer ditch using its icloud.com domain for hiding people's email addresses.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip is built for fast inference at scale, benchmarks show
articles.summary: Tested on SemiAnalysis’ InferenceX benchmark, Jalapeño registered both more tokens per user and more throughput per kilowatt than the currently available state-of-the art.

articles.title: Apple debuts its ‘most powerful chip ever’ in M5 Ultra and M6
articles.summary: Apple unveils these new processors alongside an updated Mac Mini and Mac Studio.

articles.summary: The funding, Gatik's largest so far, was led by Qatar Investment Authority and Koch Disruptive Technologies.

articles.summary: The base model of the Mac Mini comes with 256GB of storage, 16GB of RAM, and costs $899.
